remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Infor. from Miss Bry (An Amer. Place), July 1949.. . . Has not been photographed. On permanent loan to the Metropolitan Museum of Art from Georgia O'Keeffe as part of the Alfred Stieglitz Coll. Note: I may not have examined this at the Place, or it may be "Another Place Near Abiquiú." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
